title: Put a fire out
kid_text: Drown it, stir it, and make sure it is cool.
safety: A gray fire can still burn you.
Feel for heat before you leave.

steps.text: Hold the back of your hand near the coals.
If it feels hot, do not touch it.
Pour water on the coals if you have it.
If you have no water, use dirt.
Stir the ash and pour again.
Leave only when it feels cool.

mistakes.text: You touch the coals with your palm.
mistakes.fix: Use the back of your hand first.

mistakes.text: You leave while it still feels warm.
